# LSR-2 engineering budget (generated by calc/lsr2_sizing.py)

Wind: tracking 60 km/h (170 Pa), survival parked 100 km/h (473 Pa). Motor NEMA23 2.8 N·m holding, 70% usable at speed; worm efficiency 45%. Gearbox data are generic catalogue values: **verify with your supplier**.

## Torque per payload (worst axis) and gearbox choice

| Payload | Track torque (N·m) | Survival torque (N·m) | NMRV030 | NMRV040 | NMRV050 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms | 11.9 | 31.0 | ✅ 17/33 | ✅ 31/62 | ✅ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.2 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 15.4 | 40.1 | ❌ 17/33 | ✅ 31/62 | ✅ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.2 m, solid | 30.1 | 79.3 | ❌ 17/33 | ❌ 31/62 | ✅ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.8 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 51.2 | 134.3 | ❌ 17/33 | ❌ 31/62 | ❌ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.8 m, solid | 100.9 | 267.1 | ❌ 17/33 | ❌ 31/62 | ❌ 55/110 |

Cell = ✅/❌ and "available tracking torque / standstill holding torque" (N·m). ✅ needs both, plus the AZ bearing check below.

## AZ overturning moment (survival wind)

EL axis 300 mm above the upper AZ bearing; external 6206 pair, 120 mm apart, plus 51206 thrust bearing.

| Payload | Overturning (N·m) | Gearbox alone allows (NMRV030) | s0 radial pair | s0 thrust |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms | 60 | 38 | 16.1 | 291 |
| Dish 1.2 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 112 | 38 | 8.6 | 255 |
| Dish 1.2 m, solid | 224 | 38 | 4.3 | 204 |
| Dish 1.8 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 253 | 38 | 3.8 | 177 |
| Dish 1.8 m, solid | 505 | 38 | 1.9 | 124 |

**Finding:** the worm gearbox output bearings cannot carry the overturning moment of any payload above. LSR-2 therefore puts the AZ shaft in its own radial bearing pair plus the thrust bearing (cast housing), and the gearbox only transmits torque through the keyed shaft. This differs from the Mk5 load path.

## Motion

12°/s at the output = 160 rpm at the motor, 4267 steps/s at 1/8 microstep (well inside RP2040 PIO and DM542 limits).

## Recommendation

- Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms: **NMRV030**
- Dish 1.2 m, mesh (solidity 0.5): **NMRV040**
- Dish 1.2 m, solid: **NMRV050**
- Dish 1.8 m, mesh (solidity 0.5): **none of the NMRV sizes**: use a slewing drive or reduce the payload
- Dish 1.8 m, solid: **none of the NMRV sizes**: use a slewing drive or reduce the payload
